GET /api/public/v2/scores
**Deprecated:** On Langfuse Cloud, Langfuse v3 is deprecated and this endpoint will be removed on November 16, 2026. Use `GET /api/public/v3/scores` instead. Self-hosted deployments are unaffected by this date; the endpoint becomes unavailable when they upgrade to Langfuse v4. See the [Langfuse v3 to v4 upgrade guide](https://langfuse.com/self-hosting/upgrade/upgrade-guides/upgrade-v3-to-v4). Get a list of scores (supports both trace and session scores)
Optional: page (query) — Page number, starts at 1.; limit (query) — Limit of items per page. Maximum 100. Defaults to 50. Requests with a limit greater than 100 return HTTP 400. If you encounter api issues due to too large page sizes, try to reduce the limit.; userId (query) — Retrieve only scores with this userId associated to the trace.; name (query) — Retrieve only scores with this name.; fromTimestamp (query) — Optional filter to only include scores created on or after a certain datetime (ISO 8601); toTimestamp (query) — Optional filter to only include scores created before a certain datetime (ISO 8601); environment (query) — Optional filter for scores where the environment is one of the provided values.; source (query) — Retrieve only scores from a specific source.; operator (query) — Retrieve only scores with <operator> value.; value (query) — Retrieve only scores with <operator> value.; scoreIds (query) — Comma-separated list of score IDs to limit the results to.; configId (query) — Retrieve only scores with a specific configId.; sessionId (query) — Retrieve only scores with a specific sessionId.; datasetRunId (query) — Retrieve only scores with a specific datasetRunId.; traceId (query) — Retrieve only scores with a specific traceId.; observationId (query) — Comma-separated list of observation IDs to filter scores by.; queueId (query) — Retrieve only scores with a specific annotation queueId.; dataType (query) — Retrieve only scores with a specific dataType.; traceTags (query) — Only scores linked to traces that include all of these tags will be returned.; fields (query) — Comma-separated list of field groups to include in the response. Available field groups: 'score' (core score fields), 'trace' (trace properties: userId, tags, environment, sessionId). If not specified, both 'score' and 'trace' are returned by default. Example: 'score' to exclude trace data, 'score,trace' to include both. Note: When filtering by trace properties (using userId or traceTags parameters), the 'trace' field group must be included, otherwise a 400 error will be returned.; filter (query) — A JSON stringified array of filter objects. Each object requires type, column, operator, and value. Supports filtering by score metadata using the stringObject type. Example: [{"type":"stringObject","column":"metadata","key":"user_id","operator":"=","value":"abc123"}]. Supported types: stringObject (metadata key-value filtering), string, number, datetime, stringOptions, arrayOptions. Supported operators for stringObject: =, contains, does not contain, starts with, ends with, is set, is not set. Use is set / is not set to filter on metadata key presence. An empty value for contains, starts with, or ends with is treated as is set (key presence).

name: Get a list of scores with a polymorphic `value` field (v3)
description: Get a list of scores with a polymorphic `value` field (v3) Get a list of scores with a polymorphic `value` field (v3). GET /api/public/v3/scores
context:
GET /api/public/v3/scores
Get a list of scores with a polymorphic `value` field (v3). The `value` field type depends on `dataType`: - `NUMERIC` → number - `BOOLEAN` → boolean - `CATEGORICAL`, `TEXT`, `CORRECTION` → string The response always includes the core fields: id, projectId, name, value, dataType, source, timestamp, environment, createdAt, updatedAt. Additional field groups can be requested via the `fields` parameter: - `details` — adds comment, configId, metadata - `subject` — adds the subject object describing the entity the score is attached to: kind (trace, observation, session, or experiment), id, and traceId for observation-level scores - `annotation` — adds authorUserId, queueId Unknown group names return HTTP 400.
Optional: limit (query) — Number of items per page. Maximum 100, default 50. Requests with a limit greater than 100 return HTTP 400.; cursor (query) — URL-safe base64 (base64url) cursor for pagination. Use the cursor from the previous response to get the next page. Absent on the final page.; fields (query) — Comma-separated field groups to include in addition to the always-returned core fields. Allowed: details, subject, annotation — see the endpoint description for the fields each group adds. Unknown names return HTTP 400.; id (query) — Comma-separated list of score IDs to filter by (OR within, AND across filters).; name (query) — Comma-separated list of score names to filter by.; source (query) — Comma-separated list of score sources to filter by (e.g. API, ANNOTATION, EVAL). Case-insensitive — `api` and `API` are equivalent.; dataType (query) — Comma-separated list of data types to filter by (NUMERIC, BOOLEAN, CATEGORICAL, TEXT, CORRECTION). Case-insensitive — `numeric` and `NUMERIC` are equivalent. Must be a single value when used with value, valueMin, or valueMax; otherwise the request returns HTTP 400. Must be NUMERIC when used with valueMin or valueMax.; environment (query) — Comma-separated list of environments to filter by.; configId (query) — Comma-separated list of score config IDs to filter by.; queueId (query) — Comma-separated list of annotation queue IDs to filter by.; authorUserId (query) — Comma-separated list of author user IDs to filter by.; value (query) — Comma-separated list of exact values to filter by. Requires a single dataType from NUMERIC, BOOLEAN, or CATEGORICAL; any other dataType, multiple dataTypes, or omitting dataType returns HTTP 400. For BOOLEAN, each value must be "true" or "false"; for NUMERIC, each value must be a finite number. Otherwise the request returns HTTP 400.; valueMin (query) — Inclusive lower bound on the numeric value. Requires dataType=NUMERIC as a single value; otherwise the request returns HTTP 400.; valueMax (query) — Inclusive upper bound on the numeric value. Requires dataType=NUMERIC as a single value; otherwise the request returns HTTP 400.; traceId (query) — Comma-separated list of trace IDs to filter by. Mutually exclusive with sessionId, experimentId. May be combined with observationId to scope the observation lookup to a specific trace.; sessionId (query) — Comma-separated list of session IDs to filter by. Mutually exclusive with traceId, observationId, experimentId.; observationId (query) — Comma-separated list of observation IDs to filter by. Requires traceId to be specified, because observation IDs are scoped to a trace. Mutually exclusive with sessionId, experimentId. Returns HTTP 400 when used without traceId.; experimentId (query) — Comma-separated list of dataset run IDs (experiment IDs) to filter by. Mutually exclusive with traceId, sessionId, observationId.; fromTimestamp (query) — Inclusive lower bound on the score timestamp.; toTimestamp (query) — Exclusive upper bound on the score timestamp.
